declarations.docstring: A decomposition into finite pairwise nonisomorphic simple complex submodules contains a summand with the prescribed traces of all permutation operators; every other summand has traces prescribed by a different partition.

Over an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero, a decomposition into finite pairwise nonisomorphic simple submodules contains a summand with the prescribed traces of all permutation operators; every other summand has traces prescribed by a different partition.
Two simple complex submodules with equal prescribed traces for every restricted permutation operator are linearly equivalent.
For an antitone natural-valued function on `Fin N`, the displayed expression is nonzero.
Over an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero, the displayed value for an antitone natural-valued function on `Fin N` is nonzero.
